title: Random forest predicts upcoming acute kidney injury in cancer patients from blood tests
summary: A random forest trained on 597,403 blood tests from 48,865 cancer patients at one NHS trust gave AUROC 0.881 for AKI within 30 days. In a prospective analysis from June to August 2020 it identified 73.8% of patients with an AKI event before at least one occurrence, and 61.2% of AKI occurrences. It is a single trust with a three-month prospective window.
ai_technology: Random forest on routine blood test results

evidence.tested: Prospective validation from 1 June to 31 August 2020 at the same trust.
evidence.unknown: External hospital performance and effect on outcomes are not reported; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicted AKI within 30 days from routine blood tests.
